text:
sam-eng: Quick question — can we add a small "preview" mode in Console that shows a sampled, redacted playback of recent requests for a route? thinking: engineers want to eyeball what gets scrubbed without flipping full inspect.
anne-product: +1 for a preview. what's the boundary between preview & audit? compliance might still require full traces retained somewhere.
jessica-privacy: Heads-up: any preview must be strongly redacted and opt-in per tenant. Also need clear audit trail: who viewed the preview and when. :lock:
liam-sre: From infra side, previews should never bypass sampling quotas. If preview requests trigger cold paths we could spike costs. Maybe a cached 1h window used for previewing.
sam-eng: Agreed on quotas. Proposal: preview reads from the sampled telemetry buffer (same sample policy as production) but renders via the redaction pipeline in the Console render path. That way we don't change retention.
oliver-ux: UX note: make "preview" a per-route toggle with a tiny risk badge and a CTA to request elevated audit access. Keep default off and require a reason to enable.
jessica-privacy: Also ensure the redaction step is deterministic and documented. If preview shows PII leakage we need a reproducible record (hashes, rule that matched) not the raw value.
liam-sre: Implementation idea: add a lightweight endpoint GET /internal/preview/{route}?since=1h which reads from sample buffer, applies scrubbing, returns obfuscated items and matched-rule metadata. Rate-limit that endpoint and require service token.
sam-eng: rough config snippet we discussed:
```
route_preview:
  enabled: false
  sample_source: telemetry_buffer
  max_items: 50
  redact_profile: route-default
  access_role: console-audit
```
anne-product: Nice. We should surface estimated cost of doing a preview (tokens scanned) and show it in the modal so teams know tradeoffs.
liam-sre: For quotas: previews should decrement a "preview-quota" separate from live inference quota, because otherwise teams could abuse previews to test heavy payloads. We can tie default preview-quota to org size.
oliver-ux: Wireframe: preview modal -> sampling rate indicator -> summary table of redaction hits (rule, count) -> example entries (redacted) -> request full audit button.
sam-eng: Q for @jessica-privacy: can we store matched-rule names & hashed snippets for 30 days for audit? we won't store raw text.
jessica-privacy: Yes if hashes are one-way and salted per-tenant, retention documented. Need legal to sign off but looks OK.
deploy-bot: deploy queued: infra/preview-service v2 -> staging at 1789999992
sam-eng: I'll prototype, starting with read-only preview that uses same sampler as production and runs scrubbing in Console before render. Will add telemetry events: preview.viewed, preview.requested, preview.failed.
liam-sre: Add metrics to dashboards: preview_requests_per_min, preview_fail_pct, preview_cost_tokens. Also alert if preview hits >5% of route traffic.
anne-product: Let's make this a low-risk feature flag rollout: enable for internal orgs first, then beta tenants, then GA.
jessica-privacy: Final: ensure access logs include viewer identity, tenant, and reason field. :eyes:
sam-eng: thanks all — I'll open an RFC and a small spike PR.
